name: comp_small_cap_catalyst_2026-09-25
strategy: Bet on a dense cluster of dated FDA PDUFA decisions landing inside Oct 12-Nov 13 plus the adjacent Nov-Dec dates, concentrated in small/mid-cap biotech where a single binary event moves the stock. Every name carries a primary-sourced catalyst date and most show positive 90-day analyst revision flow. I avoid the pre-PDUFA run-up names with the worst CRL-tail asymmetry by keeping weights at 3-9% and holding 16 names. I would be wrong if a broad risk-off tape or a cluster of CRLs hits the book at once, since these are highly correlated binary events.
what_i_did_not_buy: ALB|net_raises -12 and lithium price forecast cut
LAC|pre-revenue, no dated catalyst in window
